title: Fascist elite preparing a thousand-year Reich, 1945-2045
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Fascist elite preparing a thousand-year Reich, 1945-2045, about 1945-2045 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> and so my hypothesis is that from 1945 until 2045 we are in a period of preparation

plain: A researcher named Jason Jorjani, speaking with a podcast host, Jesse Michels, puts forward an idea about the "thousand-year Reich," the lasting empire Nazi Germany promised itself. Jorjani says his hypothesis is that from 1945 until 2045 we are living in "a period of preparation," with a fascist elite in the United States laying the groundwork. If true, it would mean the end of the Second World War was not the end of that project.
